g.text: Objective: read the margin of safety (MoS) into a verdict, set the implied multiples beside the sector's, and write the three reports.

text.tspan: the governance discount is applied
value after governance = intrinsic value per share × (1 − governance discount)
tornado, grid and scenarios keep the raw value
the company has its verdict
MoS = value after governance ÷ latest close
the multiples are compared
the implied multiples sit beside the sector's; this decides nothing
reports/YYYY-MM-DD/analysis/TICKER.json, read by the site
schema_version 1
Comes out:
a verdict and three reports per ticker: markdown, HTML and the JSON sidecar the site reads
the value after the governance discount is set [the story's discount, else none]
value after governance = intrinsic value per share × (1 − governance discount)
the verdict reads the margin of safety (MoS) [MoS 1.3 or more]
potentially undervalued
the verdict reads the margin of safety (MoS) [MoS from 1.0 to under 1.3]
around fair value
the verdict reads the margin of safety (MoS) [MoS below 1.0]
potentially overvalued
the verdict reads the margin of safety (MoS) [no close, or a close at most 0]
n/a
implied price-to-earnings and enterprise value to sales are set beside the sector's
implied price-to-earnings (P/E) = price ÷ earnings per share (EPS), with EPS = net income ÷ diluted shares
implied enterprise value (EV) ÷ sales = EV ÷ revenue
the markdown, HTML and JSON reports are written

markdown sections: executive summary with both values, story type, assumptions with story inputs sourced story, discounted cash flow (DCF) detail, sensitivity with the scenario range, narrative flags, manual overrides, sanity check

g.text: the run of this ticker ends
